description: We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care and maintaining high standards of clinical excellence. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader committed to fostering a supportive and professional environment for both staff and residents.This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this critical leadership position promptly. Join a facility that values quality care and professional growth, where your expertise will directly impact the well-being of residents. We offer a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant difference in a vibrant healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor nursing staff
Excellent clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Credentialing Specialist for a contract role in New York, NY. This position is crucial for ensuring that our healthcare providers meet all necessary qualifications and regulatory standards, contributing to the high quality of care we provide. If you are meticulous, organized, and have a strong background in healthcare credentialing, we encourage you to apply.

This is a contract opportunity from July 20, 2026, to September 12, 2026, offering a competitive hourly rate of $27-$29. Join a dynamic team where your expertise will directly impact our operational efficiency and compliance.
requirements: 2+ years of experience in healthcare credentialing
Proficiency with credentialing software and databases
Strong understanding of credentialing standards (e.g., NCQA, JCAHO)
